description: Makes framework upgrade marker-aware when a line-based three-way merge conflicts solely because a project moved intact pre-existing protected blocks and the target template adds new protected capability blocks. The upgrade appends only the new byte-identical marker blocks to the local file; it never edits, moves, or replaces local text. Any missing pre-existing marker or altered protected block remains a blocking conflict.
verification: A project that relocates an unchanged existing marker and upgrades to a template that adds a new marker receives an APPEND-MARKERS plan item instead of a conflict
Applying APPEND-MARKERS preserves the local text, appends the new marker byte-for-byte, and adds any new managed file
Any changed or missing inherited protected marker still returns a blocking conflict
